app/app/utils/poke.ts:64-78 — promise cache is unbounded and process-lifetime; acceptable for a fixed dataset and spec-sanctioned, but worth a comment on eviction
correctness_risks.rationale: No serious bug, but several minor fragilities: build-time config baking, a leaked debounce timer that mutates the URL after navigation, unhandled API errors bypassing the required landmark layout, and a broken-image fallback for null sprite URLs.

app/app/utils/poke.ts:54-62 — module-level mutable resolvedApiBase shared across all SSR requests, synced by app/app/plugins/api-base.ts:4; documented but a global side-channel

evidence: app/.nuxt/, app/.output/, app/.data/ and empty app/server/ are present with no app/.gitignore (root .gitignore:1-3 doesn't cover them) — generated artifacts would be committed
app/nuxt.config.ts:6-10 — one small change to fix the build-time config baking (use NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL or a server-side runtime read)

review_cost.rationale: Approve after a round of small, well-localised changes: gitignore, runtime env handling, timer cleanup, v-model. Nothing structural needs rework.

findings.issue: runtimeConfig.public.apiBaseUrl is evaluated from process.env.API_BASE_URL at build time and serialized into the output (app/.output/server/chunks/nitro/nitro.mjs:4131), so a runtime API_BASE_URL is silently ignored; the plugin at app/app/plugins/api-base.ts:4 then clobbers the correct runtime-time read in app/app/utils/poke.ts:54.
findings.suggestion: Keep a static default in nuxt.config and set NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (or map API_BASE_URL in a server plugin) so the value is read at request time, per Nuxt's runtime-config env-override convention.

findings.issue: Generated .nuxt/, .output/ and .data/kv/ (and an empty server/ directory) live under app/ with no ignore rule; the root .gitignore only covers /data/ and node_modules, so build artifacts would be committed.
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore with node_modules, .nuxt, .output, .data; delete the empty app/server/.

findings.issue: Direct fetchApi calls (default-variety Pokémon, evolution chain, type/generation indexes) are not wrapped in error handling and there is no app/error.vue, so any non-404 API failure renders Nuxt's default error page without the banner/nav/contentinfo landmarks the spec requires on every page.
findings.suggestion: Add a custom app/error.vue with the site landmarks, or catch and null-out failures so the NotFound branch renders.

findings.issue: The search debounce timer is never cleared on unmount; typing then navigating away within 250ms fires router.replace and attaches {q: ...} to the new page's URL.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in onUnmounted (or use a watchEffect/vueuse useDebounceFn scoped to the component).

findings.issue: One module owns transport, the promise cache, module-level global state, four index builders and the card view-model; every page imports it, and future changes all land in the same 270-line file.
findings.suggestion: Split into api.ts (fetch + cache + config), indexes.ts, and cards.ts, and move the base-URL plumbing into a composable using useRuntimeConfig().

findings.issue: The API boundary is untyped (Promise<any>, inline casts like `toTree(node: any)` at app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:53), so record-shape changes surface as runtime errors rather than type errors.
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the API records actually used (species, pokemon, move, ability, type) and type fetchRecord's return.

findings.issue: Filter selects bind :selected on <option> plus a manual @change handler instead of v-model; Vue documents :selected as an initial-DOM-value edge case and v-model is the supported pattern.
findings.suggestion: Use v-model with a writable computed that reads from and writes to the route query.

findings.issue: Switching the game select refetches every move record for that version group from the browser (hundreds of requests, mapLimit 16) on a client-only path; cached, but heavy on slow links.
findings.suggestion: Consider a server route that assembles the table rows, or shipping the move metadata alongside the page payload.

findings.issue: The artwork chain always ends in spriteUrl(pokemon.id), so a null sprite set (the spec says sprite URLs can be null) renders a broken image instead of a graceful fallback.
findings.suggestion: Fall back to nothing/alt-only when both official artwork and front sprite are null.

findings.issue: compatibilityDate is pinned to 2025-01-01 while running Nuxt 4.6.3 (2026-10); it silences newer default behavior the team may expect.
findings.suggestion: Bump the compatibility date to the release date of the Nuxt version in use.

summary: A solid, idiomatic Nuxt 4 submission on the current stable release, with clean page structure, consistent patterns and a well-commented data layer. Merge-blockers are modest: build-time baking of the API base URL, missing ignore rules for generated artifacts, and a leaked debounce timer. The single 270-line, untyped data module is the main maintainability debt.
